title: Evaluating Position Bias in Large Language Model Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Systematically prompting the LLM with input lists differing in the positional order of candidate items and measuring the divergence between the resulting output rankings using Kendall's tau coefficient.

Generating candidate item lists using different sampling strategies based on item popularity distributions (Full, Top, Middle, Bottom, Intertwined) to examine its relationship with and influence on position bias.
